additional_info.subject: RE: ID0371110-DC/Si-D/FR-[qZ8gh8]- Outlet 2 charging issue CRM:00645000706
additional_info.body:
Hello team,
With reference to the trailing mail, we have gone through the logs and found that-
The contactors are failing to give close feedback while cable check.
Suspected root causes :
Faulty contactor
Excitation supply circuit problem (State monitor and Relays)
Hence, we need to plan site intervention to check contactors QA13-14 and all the connections corresponding to it. Also need to check relays and state monitor device.
We will suggest you to carry spare parts along with you while being onsite. Especially the contactors, because if found faulty then need to replace them.
We will wait for your feedback, to proceed further accordingly.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
